verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Omnara serves an llms.txt at docs.omnara.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It indexes markdown versions of the docs (e.g. introduction.md, quickstart.md), and a machine-readable openapi.json is also served, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt / agent-docs feature (e.g. an llms-full.txt or usage guidance).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
